The `/partners` gate is in [I:/Scratch/_trimtest/T4-A-2/proxy.ts](proxy.ts), and nothing is committed. I haven't run it or opened any page, so everything below comes from reading the code, not from seeing it work (page-claim:allow).

**How it works:** anyone going to `/partners` or any page under it needs the same signed-in cookie (`sol_client`) that the `/client` gate checks. That cookie is only issued after `/client/login` accepts a client's password. Anyone without it is redirected to `/client/login`. Paths are normalised the same way as the other gates, so `/%70artners` or `/PARTNERS` can't slip past.

**Three gaps:**
1. **There is no `/partners` page in the repo yet.** The gate guards a route that doesn't exist, so a signed-in visitor would get a 404.
2. **Any client can open it.** `/client/<slug>` pages also check which workspace the client belongs to. `/partners` has no workspace in its URL, so any signed-in client gets through.
3. **People probably won't be sent back to `/partners` after signing in.** The login page only reads `c`, `e` and `sent` from the URL, so it has nowhere to record the page someone came from. I haven't checked where it does send them.

**Checks:** type-checking shows no errors in `proxy.ts`. The overall type-check still exits with code 1 because of errors in other files, which I haven't looked into.
